name: crystal_prune
description: Permanently prune a crystal or cold storage archives by retention policy (with entity and artifact cascade).

crystal_id.description: Crystal identifier to prune (active or archived)

older_than.description: Batch prune archived crystals inactive for duration (e.g. 30d, 2w, 3m)

all.description: Batch prune all archived crystals in cold storage (default: false)

dry_run.description: Preview candidates and cascade impact without deleting (default: false for batch prune)

force.description: Force pruning without confirmation prompt (default: true for single crystal prune, false for batch prune)
